title: lathyrus linnaei
intro: Lathyrus linnaei, commonly known as the spring vetchling or vetchling, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus linnaei include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
